evidence.reason: In drivers/cq.py the fallback sessionId now comes from this invocation's `created` session files (stem of the single new file) instead of the whole store listing, so a deferred rung retrying in the same directory and failing before creating a session can no longer claim an earlier run's session; `sessionIds` still reports the full store listing.
